raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Customers migrated to the new CRM carry numeric region codes ('01'-'04') instead of region names. raw_region_map gives the mapping (01=WEST, 02=EAST, 03=NORTH, 04=SOUTH), and the change note confirms it is the intended lookup. silver_customers should map codes to names and leave existing names unchanged.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.93,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_customers":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, upper(coalesce(m.region_name, c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON c.region = m.region_code"}}
